/></figure></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><p class="wp-block-paragraph">This is our boutique style hostel and it is located half way between Flag Beach and Corralejo town centre in a tranquil location just across the road from the Campanario shopping centre with supermarket, bars and restaurants as well as a bustling Sunday market.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">The house sleeps 14 people with twin and double rooms and a dorm with bunk beds. Single travellers can take the double room at a slightly reduced rate if not sharing. There are 3 modern bathrooms with shower, and common areas include living room/kitchen (TV), and al fresco dining area for all and a BBQ offer a friendly and relaxing vibe after a day on the beach.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph">The two terraces and private pool with sun loungers is great for afternoons away for the bustle of town.</p><p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p><h3
